title: Tanker Shipping - October 6, 2026
summary: Disrupted Vessel Circulation, Atlantic Tightening, Drives New Records - The Short-term Indicators close of the third quarter left crude freight at exceptionally high levels, with the Momentum: Negative consequences of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline disruption still shaping the Sentiment: Positive eastern market and Atlantic tightening providing stronger support to owners. Middle East crude exports averaged 18.5 million bpd in the seven days to October Fundamentals: Positive 1, according to provisional estimates, exceeding the pre-war regional average of 18 million bpd. The total includes shipments through Hormuz and the Red Sea, Breakwave Tanker 18453 loadings from other regional terminals and ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Futures Index: Oman.
